title: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for WPLJ | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview to WPLJ-FM on 23 January 1972.

The interviewer was Howard Smith, who had spoken to the couple on several prior occasions. It was recorded at their apartment at 105 Bank Street in Greenwich Village, New York City.

The interview took place while the radio station was playing a marathon of Beatles songs. Lennon’s radio was tuned to the station, and they turned down the volume when he wished to voice his thoughts and opinions.
